description: Resume a paused People Search task and return its updated status. Free. The search continues from where it stopped, keeping the people already found, with no new charge: the cost already spent is carried forward and the original reservation still covers it. Works only on a paused search, within 7 days of pausing; a search in any other state, including one the API cancelled after 7 days paused, returns 409. Poll people-search-status for the new people.
name: people-search-resume
title: Resume People Search
